tagline: Rural family-school students planting native Amazonian trees on their family properties — one verified tree, one credential.
description_md:
A partnership between **CEPOTX** (Cooperativa Central de Produção Orgânica da Transamazônica e Xingu) and the **Casa Familiar Rural de Anapu "Dorothy Stang"** — a rural family school (*pedagogia da alternância*) in Anapu, Pará, Brazil — supported by the **SunMint** tree-planting program of TrueTech Inc / TrueSight DAO.

Students plant native Amazonian trees on their own family properties. For each **verified tree** — GPS coordinates, supported species, planting date, and a planting photo submitted as a file so its GPS/EXIF metadata is preserved — the supporter pays **R$ 5.00 directly to the student via PIX**. Cacao-based agroforestry, with native shade and timber trees, is expressly supported. Students are also planting **açaí**, a native Amazonian fruit palm.

This is a **"Credential + trees"** partner (route B of the DAO's Lineage credentialing platform): each attested student receives a verifiable credential, and a serialized tree-planting pledge is bound to that student — the tree's QR code and the student's credential page point at each other, and the public Impact Map carries passive proof of each planted tree.
